```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  message = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE,
  fig.align = "center"
)

library(tidyverse)
library(knitr)
library(lubridate)

# Load processed datasets
food <- read_csv("../../data/processed/FoodInspectionData_cleaned.csv")
closed <- read_csv("../../data/processed/Closed_Food_Establishments_cleaned.csv")

# Cities need enough inspections for closure_rate to be stable.
MIN_INSPECTIONS_CITY <- 50L

violation_cols_food <- c(
  "Food.from.Approved.Source..C.",
  "Food.Protected.from.Contamination..C.",
  "Ill.Workers.Restricted..C.",
  "Proper.Hand.Washing..C.",
  "Cooling.Time.and.Temperature..C.",
  "Cold.Holding.Temperature..C.",
  "Hot.Holding.Temperature..C.",
  "Cooking.Time.and.Temperature..C.",
  "Reheating.Time.and.Temperature..C.",
  "Hot.and.Cold.Running.Water.Provided..C.",
  "Proper.Sewage.Disposal..C.",
  "Toxic.Substances...Pesticides",
  "Rodents.and.Insects"
)

# Closed extract uses "Rodent.and.Insects" singular, so include both versions.
violation_cols_closed_plot <- unique(c(violation_cols_food, "Rodent.and.Insects"))

theme_project <- function() {
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(color = "gray35"),
      axis.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
      axis.text = element_text(color = "gray15"),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major.x = element_line(color = "gray88"),
      panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
      plot.title.position = "plot"
    )
}
```

## EDA Summary

```{r eda-summary}
closure_row_share <- nrow(closed) / nrow(food)

kable(
  tibble(
    Metric = c(
      "Unique inspections in main file",
      "Closure rows after deduplication",
      "Distinct closed establishments",
      "Date range in closure file",
      "Closure rows / all inspection rows"
    ),
    Value = c(
      nrow(food),
      nrow(closed),
      n_distinct(closed$Establishment.ID, na.rm = TRUE),
      paste(
        format(min(closed$Inspection.Date, na.rm = TRUE), "%Y-%m-%d"),
        "to",
        format(max(closed$Inspection.Date, na.rm = TRUE), "%Y-%m-%d")
      ),
      sprintf("%.2f%%", 100 * closure_row_share)
    )
  )
)
```

## Missingness Check

```{r eda-missingness}
missing_tbl <- bind_rows(
  tibble(
    dataset = "food",
    variable = c("Inspection.results", "Inspection.Date", "Zip"),
    missing_n = c(
      sum(is.na(food$Inspection.results) | food$Inspection.results == ""),
      sum(is.na(food$Inspection.Date)),
      sum(is.na(food$Zip) | food$Zip == "")
    )
  ),
  tibble(
    dataset = "closed",
    variable = c("Inspection.Results", "Inspection.Date", "Zip"),
    missing_n = c(
      sum(is.na(closed$Inspection.Results) | closed$Inspection.Results == ""),
      sum(is.na(closed$Inspection.Date)),
      sum(is.na(closed$Zip) | closed$Zip == "")
    )
  )
)

kable(missing_tbl)
```

## Visual 1: Overall Inspection Outcomes

```{r visual-outcomes, fig.width=8, fig.height=5}
food %>%
  count(Inspection.results, sort = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(Inspection.results = fct_reorder(Inspection.results, n)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Inspection.results, y = n)) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue", width = 0.72, alpha = 0.95) +
  geom_text(aes(label = format(n, big.mark = ",")), hjust = 1.05, color = "white", size = 3.2) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_comma(), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.08))) +
  labs(
    title = "Inspection outcomes in FoodInspectionData",
    subtitle = "Outcome mix is dominated by non-closure results; closure-type outcomes are rare",
    x = "Inspection result",
    y = "Count"
  ) +
  theme_project()
```

```text
EDA/images/viz1_inspection_outcomes.png
```

## Visual 2: Most Common Out-of-Compliance Issues Among Closures

```{r visual-violations, fig.width=9, fig.height=6}
closed %>%
  select(any_of(violation_cols_closed_plot)) %>%
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "rule", values_to = "status") %>%
  mutate(status = str_trim(as.character(status))) %>%
  filter(!is.na(status), status == "Out of Compliance") %>%
  count(rule, sort = TRUE) %>%
  slice_head(n = 10) %>%
  mutate(
    rule = str_replace_all(rule, "\\.", " "),
    rule = fct_reorder(rule, n)
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = rule, y = n)) +
  geom_col(fill = "firebrick", width = 0.72, alpha = 0.92) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_comma(), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.08))) +
  labs(
    title = "Top out-of-compliance issues in closed establishments",
    subtitle = "Top 10 repeated findings among closure events",
    x = "Inspection rule",
    y = "Count of out-of-compliance findings"
  ) +
  theme_project()
```

```text
EDA/images/viz2_top_violations.png
```

## Visual 3: Closure Trend Over Time

```{r visual-trend, fig.width=9, fig.height=4}
closed %>%
  mutate(month = floor_date(Inspection.Date, "month")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(month)) %>%
  count(month) %>%
  ggplot(aes(month, n)) +
  geom_line(color = "darkgreen", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(color = "darkgreen", size = 2.1, alpha = 0.9) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "red", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.85) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_comma(), expand = expansion(mult = c(0.03, 0.08))) +
  labs(
    title = "Monthly number of closure inspections",
    subtitle = "Dashed line is a linear trend reference",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Count"
  ) +
  theme_project()
```

## Visual 5: City Closure Rate

```{r city-risk-table}
city_risk <- food %>%
  filter(!is.na(City), City != "") %>%
  count(City, name = "inspection_rows") %>%
  left_join(
    closed %>%
      filter(!is.na(City), City != "") %>%
      count(City, name = "closure_rows"),
    by = "City"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    closure_rows = replace_na(as.integer(closure_rows), 0L),
    closure_rate = closure_rows / inspection_rows,
    se = sqrt((closure_rate * (1 - closure_rate)) / inspection_rows),
    rate_lo = pmax(closure_rate - 1.96 * se, 0),
    rate_hi = pmin(closure_rate + 1.96 * se, 1)
  ) %>%
  filter(inspection_rows >= MIN_INSPECTIONS_CITY)

kable(
  city_risk %>%
    arrange(desc(closure_rate), desc(inspection_rows)) %>%
    mutate(
      closure_rate_pct = sprintf("%.3f%%", 100 * closure_rate),
      ci_95 = sprintf("[%.3f%%, %.3f%%]", 100 * rate_lo, 100 * rate_hi)
    ) %>%
    select(City, inspection_rows, closure_rows, closure_rate_pct, ci_95) %>%
    slice_head(n = 25)
)
```

```{r city-risk-plot, fig.width=9, fig.height=6}
city_risk %>%
  arrange(desc(closure_rate)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 15) %>%
  mutate(City = fct_reorder(City, closure_rate)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = City, y = closure_rate)) +
  geom_col(fill = "darkslateblue", alpha = 0.9, width = 0.72) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = rate_lo, ymax = rate_hi),
    width = 0.22,
    color = "gray35",
    linewidth = 0.45
  ) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_percent(accuracy = 0.1)) +
  labs(
    title = sprintf("City closure rate: closure rows / inspection rows (min %d inspections)", MIN_INSPECTIONS_CITY),
    subtitle = "Bars = point estimate; error bars approximate 95% Wald CIs",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Closure rate"
  ) +
  theme_project()
```

